Support security incident investigations to determine root cause, assess potential impact, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate with the Cyber Incident and Event Management team during security incidents, escalations, and high-priority operational events. Support continuous improvement of incident response procedures, security monitoring capabilities, and operational workflows. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of security tools, processes, and technical capabilities in alignment with customer requirements. Threat Detection and Security Analysis Analyze security events, alerts, and log data to identify potential indicators of compromise and malicious activity. Support the use and optimization of enterprise security monitoring technologies, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and related security platforms.
